items.title: Confirm whether to commission the Gutachten
items.quote: Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn- und Feiertage.
items.computation: Letter date (Briefdatum) is Friday 20.11.2026; the period runs 'nach dem Briefdatum' (after the letter date), so the letter date itself is not counted and counting starts on 21.11.2026 (§187 Abs. 1 BGB analogy). The letter itself defines 'Werktage' as Monday to Saturday, excluding Sunday and public holidays, so each Saturday counts but each Sunday and holiday is skipped. Counting working days from 21.11.2026: 21.11 Sat=1, 23.11 Mon=2, 24.11 Tue=3, 25.11 Wed=4, 26.11 Thu=5, 27.11 Fri=6, 28.11 Sat=7, 30.11 Mon=8, 01.12 Tue=9, 02.12 Wed=10, 03.12 Thu=11, 04.12 Fri=12, 05.12 Sat=13, 07.12 Mon=14, 08.12 Tue=15 (Sundays 22.11, 29.11 and 06.12 skipped; no NRW public holidays fall in this window). The 15th working day is Tuesday 08.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further shift is needed.
